summary: Demonic Pact build: the Imp is sacrificed before the pull for 15% Shadow damage and the Succubus stays out for Master Demonologist, Soul Link and Demonic Knowledge. The highest-DPS warlock build and the class default.
rotation: Pre-pull: Soul Link at -6 s, Life Tap at -4.5 s, Shadow Bolt at -2.5 s (lands just after the pull)
Life Tap below 5% mana or when the filler costs more than the mana left
Bane of Doom when it lands before the fight ends (more than 60 s left)
Bane of Agony while Bane of Doom is on cooldown or would not land
Corruption when down or under 1.5 s left (more than 9 s of fight left)
Immolate when down or under 1.5 s left (more than 6 s of fight left)
Death Coil, then Searing Pain, when the filler would not land before the fight ends
caveats: Two synthetic item level 71 trinkets (Forever's launch trinkets aren't simulated): 38 spell power and 13 crit rating, and 140 spell power for 20 s every 2 min, used in the opening seconds and again on cooldown
Demon model is most sensitive here: no owner scaling 1037.8, Succubus melee halved 1044.5, both 1011.5 (first set)
Wears the Demonology hit-variant gear (14% gear hit, 1 point of Suppression); Suppression 5/5 is 72 behind (1038.0 against 1110.1)
Demon scaling uses Season of Discovery placeholder coefficients (Forever's are server-side): worth +49 on Demonology, +39 on the other builds
Succubus base melee is unverified: halved melee would cost Demonology 43, the other builds 38 to 39
Bane of Doom coefficient 4.0 (Era 1.0) is about 12% of Shadow Bolt builds' damage; at 2.0 they lose about 4%, at 1.0 about 6%
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks (Shadow Bolt IX, Immolate VII, Corruption VI): 7 to 13 DPS below rank X/VIII/VII
Only the Demonheart Raiment 2-piece is live (the 5-piece added about +8 to +13 on the first set)
Soul shards and Life Tap health cost are not tracked
Demons take the warlock's spell crit as their own melee and spell crit, with no crit of their own (Blizzard's intent, forever-bugs #331; user ruling 2026-10-16); worth 15 to 17 DPS
notes: Request straight from mksettings -spec demonology -gear level60_phase1_synthetic_demonology -apl level60_demonology -race Human -duration 180, no edits. Demon Armor; Summon Succubus, sacrificed Imp, imbue Spellstone. mksettings sets distanceFromTarget 5 / channelClipDelayMs 50 where the UI preset uses 25 / 150; the published numbers were made with mksettings and reproduce exactly.
